title: CrowdStrike fiscal Q1 2027 results exhibit
excerpt: Fiscal-2027 guidance was USD 5.9147-5.9587 billion of revenue and 259 million diluted shares before the four-for-one split; fiscal Q1 free cash flow was USD 468.463 million on USD 1.386 billion of revenue.
summary: The unchanged results exhibit supports the revenue range, current free-cash-flow margin, split, ARR growth and module-adoption inputs used in the bear, base and bull scenarios.
